§6§lTEN STEPS DONE. THE CAMPAIGN HAS NOT STARTED YET.§r
Everything up to step 10 was CONSTRUCTION. From here the plant earns its own upgrades, and it earns them by §6RUNNING§r - not by crafting anything, not by placing another block, not by opening another quest.

§e§lFOUR LINES, SEVEN TIERS EACH§r
At the foot of every panel - the controller GUI, both control blocks, the handheld scanner - there is a group headed §bMILESTONES§r. Four counters, each a ladder of seven tiers, each watching something the plant already knew about itself:

  §bUPTIME§r        generating ticks
  §bBURNUP§r        fuel segments, weighted by rod grade
  §bREPROCESSING§r  Extraction Derrick loads + Enrichment Annex batches
  §bTURBINE§r       perfectly timed cycles

A fresh plant reads §8UPTIME T0/7§r and §80 generating ticks§r. Leave it lit and it starts climbing within the hour.

§e§lWHAT A TIER PAYS§r
§bTiers 1-4 pay a MULTIPLIER§r straight into the EU/t derivation you learned to read in step 10. It is not a hidden bonus: line 3 of the MATH panel grows a labelled factor the moment it is above 1.000, and prints it beside the terms it multiplies.
§bTiers 5-7 pay an UNLOCK§r - a NEW MAXIMUM. The control rods withdraw past the 24/24 design stop. The turbine redline lifts off 12,000. The feedwater draw halves again. The process modules turn over faster.
§bEvery tier also pays PROGRESSION POINTS§r, and those are the currency of the §bUpgrade Tree§r - see the next two quests.

§a§2Nothing here can take away anything you already have.§r Every unlock raises a ceiling; none of them gates a capability. A plant sitting at zero progress does exactly what it did before this system existed, down to the last EU.

§e§lDO THIS§r
§b1.§r Open any panel and scroll to §bMILESTONES§r. Read the four lines and the roll-up under them.
§b2.§r Keep the plant lit. The lines that matter most early are UPTIME (it only needs the plant GENERATING) and TURBINE (it needs a steam slug and all eight injectors landed - a perfect cycle, every cycle).
§b3.§r Come back when the roll-up stops saying §8Milestones 0/28§r.

§a§lDONE WHEN§r
You tick it, once you have found the MILESTONES group and read it.

§8A TICK BOX on purpose: a milestone tier is not an item, and there is nothing to carry into a quest window.§r

[note]§lWhere the progress lives.§r On §bTHIS CONTROLLER§r, in its own NBT - not on you, and not on the world. It survives a world reload, a chunk unloading and coming back, the structure un-forming and re-forming, and a §bwrench§r: pick the main station up and the campaign rides along in the item, then loads straight back when you place it. A controller that has never earned anything still stacks like an ordinary machine.[/note]

[warn]There is no back-fill. However long this plant has been running, the four counters start at ZERO the first time you load 0.22.0. That is deliberate - the alternative was inventing a history the plant never recorded.[/warn]
